host: GitHub disposable macOS 26 with AX-approved probe; two test-owned native AppKit processes per scenario
reproduction: Build 527 passed the no-write assertion with a held pointing-device guard, then failed to displace the same overlapping window after that guard cleared. A test seam provides the guard reading; all window IDs, native AX setters and readbacks are real. No mouse event was posted. The original intermittent CI report did not measure which precondition rejected its first write.
product_change: A preflight that issued neither a position nor a size setter leaves eligibility for future observations. A setter actually issued with partial or unreadable results is still held against repeat mutation. The same distinction applies to restoration.
scope: The hosted test excludes real user windows. Native fullscreen was not requested in these geometry trials. Each raw report separately preserves the prior platform observation about AppKit minimum size normalization.
